observer.role: Track requirements, stage completion, reviewer findings, and final gate status.

run.title: Her Mood Changed His Hand Didnt

source_inputs.story: Selected concept from the Golden Theme tournament: Her mood changed. His hand did not. Universal relationship truth: some moods change mid-walk, and love is the person who notices both the feeling and the hand still reaching. She feels everything fully: sudden quiet, full-face emotions, tiny dramatic turns, and softness returning. He does not make the feeling smaller; he slows the world down, keeps his hand steady, and walks at her pace. Public slide copy must be exactly: Slide 1: Some moods change mid-walk. Slide 2: She feels everything fully. Slide 3: Her hand still reaches. Slide 4: He slows the world down. Slide 5: Love keeps pace.

requirements.label: Use desi storybook / photo-rooted illustration style
Preserve supplied photo cues, outfits, settings, poses, and relationship energy
Aachu/Zuv identity reference is present in manifest and prompt pack
Face structure, expressions, clothing, and cross-slide identity continuity are reviewed before image generation
Create exactly 4 or 5 carousel slides, matching prompt count
Final generated carousel images are packaged from approved generated art, not local placeholders
Default final slides include model-rendered copy and brandmark inside final/slide-XX.png
Structured face and storyboard visual QA gate passes with evidence
Keep @a.storyof.two as a tiny, low-contrast bottom-right brandmark
Block photorealism, 3D rendering, generic stock couple art, and quote-card layout
Enrich wiki, index, working memory, and graph memory after the run

notes: Wiki and memory files are updated after final audit generation.
